method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading and reverse paraphrase of reducibility motivation, K/K_0 example and both reduction definitions, with exact formula, macro, token, label and reference parity after one documented pair-order projection. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Many-one reducibility, its computational-complexity context, the K-to-K_0 diagonal reduction and the stronger one-one requirement.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Reducibility transfers answers about B membership into answers about A membership, allowing noncomputability results beyond K_0. Many-one is one of several reduction notions. In complexity theory the similar NP-completeness example additionally requires polynomial-time computability of the reduction.
samples.checks: The direction from A to B, noncomputability versus c.e. distinction, NP-set condition, every-NP-problem condition and time requirement are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: K consists of self-halting indices x, equivalently x in W_x. K_0 contains coded pairs (e,x) with φ_e(x) defined, equivalently x in W_e. If K_0 were computable, checking (x,x) in K_0 would decide K, so x↦(x,x) reduces K to K_0.
samples.checks: The halting-problem reference, both set formulas, self-pair map and reduction direction remain exact. OLCMP-021 repairs the frozen reversed pair in the W_e reformulation.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A total computable f from naturals to naturals many-one reduces A to B exactly when, for every natural x, x belongs to A iff f(x) belongs to B. Existence is written A≤_m B; reduction in both directions is A≡_m B.
samples.checks: Total function type, universal quantifier, iff, subscript m and two directions of equivalence are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If such a reduction f is injective, it is a one-one reduction. This is genuinely stronger: some infinite A and B admit an A-to-B many-one reduction but no A-to-B one-one reduction. The text does not use the injective strength later.
samples.checks: The injectivity condition, stronger versus weaker distinction, infinity of both sets and unused-status caveat are preserved.

source_observations: T329 records many-one and one-one as transparent specialist compounds grounded in the attested reduction headword T074 and one-to-one component T049; the full phrases remain expert-reviewable.
OLCMP-021 corrects only the ordered-pair order in the W_e reformulation. All protected tokens and other formulas remain identical.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
NP-पूर्ण, संगणकीय गुंतागुंत and बहुपदी वेळ are transparent contextual renderings, not independently attested full-term headwords in this checkpoint.
